findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "chat_reply" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "chat" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chat_get_setup, chat_list_conversations, chat_get_conversation, chat_create_ticket, account_set_owner_email, account_get_limits, account_search, account_get_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_save_team, account_data_locations · Private data: chat_create_ticket, chat_reply, account_owner_link, account_search, account_set_brand, account_export_all, account_audit_log, account_find_person, account_export_person, account_erase_person, account_data_locations · Public sink: chat_setup, chat_list_conversations, chat_create_ticket, chat_reply, chat_wait, account_set_owner_email, account_owner_link, account_get_limits, account_request_limit, account_emit_event, account_set_brand, account_list_email_templates, account_set_email_template, account_save_team, account_add_approval_rule, account_find_person, account_data_locations · Destructive: account_balance, account_add_approval_rule.
